items.name: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3
items.description: ESP32-S3 thumb-size board, 21x17.8 mm, USB-C, LiPo charging
items.selection_reason: Smallest indexed MCU with LiPo charging and USB-C; fits behind the display in a 22 mm thick shell.

cad_relevance.notes: USB-C opening on shell side; 21x17.8 mm board pocket

items.name: Grove - 1.2 Inch IPS Display
items.description: 1.2 in 240x240 IPS, ST7789, 2-wire serial, 40x40 mm board, screen 24.76x26.8 mm
items.selection_reason: Square colour screen like the reference; the only indexed 240x240 square IPS module.

cad_relevance.notes: 40x40 mm board pocket and screen window

items.name: 3.7V LiPo 503035 500mAh (35x30x5 mm) with 2-wire lead
items.selection_reason: Default size that fits under the display board inside the shell.

cad_relevance.notes: tray 30.6 x 35.6 mm behind the display (cell laid with its 30 mm side across); leads to XIAO BAT+/BAT- pads

items.name: K2-1102DP-C4SW-04
items.description: Tactile Switch SPST 250gf 5mm 6mm x 6mm Through Hole
items.selection_reason: Supplier drawing p1: 6x6 body, 5 mm total height, 6.5x4.5 mm pin spacing; supplier footprint selected. Pins 1/2 common, pins 3/4 common; press joins the two groups.

cad_relevance.notes: Fixed released PCB switches; visible caps cluster via three detachable 1.2 mm eccentric pushers: side caps 3 mm inward/2 mm down, middle cap 1 mm up; pitch23.428 mm. Pushers press onto 3.2 mm cap pegs; shoulder transmits force.

items.name: M2 x 6 mm countersunk cross-recess machine screw (ISO 7046), black
items.description: closes the back half into printed standoffs; self-forms its thread in PETG
items.selection_reason: Solved by the printed screw joint for a 2 mm back wall plus 4 mm engagement.

cad_relevance.notes: countersunk flush in the back face

items.name: 30 AWG silicone hookup wire, ~60 cm
items.description: Two four-wire PCB pigtails; board ends soldered directly to J_KEYS/J_LCD_MCU holes; display harness detachable at the inward-facing XIAO header.
items.selection_reason: Default wire allowance for eight short conductors plus service slack, 0.8 mm maximum insulation diameter in the routing envelope.

items.name: Double-sided foam tape, 1 mm thick
items.description: holds the XIAO on its ledges and the battery in its tray
items.selection_reason: The XIAO has no mounting holes; tape is the vendor-neutral way to fix it.

items.name: Printed parts: front shell, back shell, screen bezel, 3 button caps, 3 eccentric pushers
items.description: FDM PETG: lavender shells, caps and detachable pushers; dark bezel. Caps insert from the outside; pushers press onto cap pegs from inside.

items.name: 2.54 mm right-angle male pin header, 1x4 (cut from a 1x40 strip)
items.description: soldered on the XIAO underside at GND, 3V3, D10, D9
items.selection_reason: XIAO display header faces inward under the XIAO; the four female housings point toward +Y, clear of PCB and closure bosses.

cad_relevance.notes: 2.5 mm plastic body under the XIAO edge

items.name: HX PZ2.54-1x4P ZZ
items.description: Pin Header 4 Position 2.54mm Pitch Single Row Through Hole -40°C~+105°C
items.selection_reason: DNP headers: solder low-profile wire pigtails to the existing through-hole pads instead, retaining XIAO-side detachability. Required by 22 mm enclosure height.

cad_relevance.notes: Both header footprints remain DNP; solder pigtails directly. No vertical headers or rear female plugs.

items.name: ZX-HY2.0-4PWZ
items.description: Connector Header 4 position 2mm Pitch 2A Right Angle -25°C~+85°C
items.selection_reason: Right-angle HY 2.0 mm 4P. Drawing matches Grove NS-Tech mating geometry: 10 mm housing, 3.5 mm key, 0.5 mm square pins; 5.1 mm height. Validate final pin order against source Grove schematic.

cad_relevance.notes: Rear central bridge at PCB (10,-5), rotation180; shell (10,-26.5), opens +Y; plug envelope checked.

items.name: Pet device key and Grove carrier PCB, 59x26.5 mm shaped outline, 2-layer FR4 1.6 mm 1 oz
items.selection_reason: User requested custom key board and integrated display Grove socket; outline and boss notches fitted to cloud shell.
